name: roku-fish
description: REEFBOUND: The Living Reef - Roku channel (BrightScript 2D API) with its art, audio and data build tools.

scripts.export:data: cd "${REEFBOUND_DIR:-../REEFBOUND}" && REEFBOUND_DIR="$PWD" OUT_DIR="$OLDPWD/channel/data" TOOLS_OUT_DIR="$OLDPWD/tools/art/data" npx vite-node "$OLDPWD/tools/export-data/export.ts"
scripts.test: bsc --project bsconfig.json && node tools/build.mjs && node tools/sim/run.mjs --script=tools/sim/scripts/smoke.mjs --quiet
